name: ssh-bridge
description: Compact, reusable SSH project workflows with connection reuse, guarded edits and bounded output.

interface.shortDescription: Work on SSH hosts from local Codex.
interface.longDescription: Open remote projects once, reuse named tasks, inspect output on demand and forward local ports using existing SSH configuration.
defaultPrompt: Open the remote file browser for the configured SSH host.
Inspect the remote project and explain its structure.
Run the requested tests on the remote host.
